description: Single-use, human-reviewed exceptions that let EXACTLY these migration files (by SHA-256) reach the persistent shared staging database before their PR merges, through the Staging Reviewed Migration Preview workflow only. Merging an entry records the review; it applies nothing. Applying needs a dispatch that restates every digest plus a staging-migration-approval environment approval. See docs/STAGING_REVIEWED_MIGRATION_PREVIEW.md.

preconditions.name: h1_synthetic_only_check_present
preconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_h1_synthetic_only' and contype = 'c' and convalidated)

preconditions.name: h1_state_check_present_without_awaiting_approval
preconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_state_check' and contype = 'c' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) not like '%awaiting_approval%')

preconditions.name: h1_step_type_check_present
preconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_run_steps'::regclass and conname = 'agent_run_steps_step_type_check' and contype = 'c')

preconditions.name: h2_objects_absent
preconditions.probe: select to_regclass('public.agent_tool_invocations') is null and to_regclass('public.agent_execution_enablement') is null and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc where pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and proname in ('work_order_assign_apply', 'agent_tool_run_admit', 'agent__guard_gateway_run_insert'))

preconditions.name: existing_runs_fit_h2_agent_allowlist
preconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from public.agent_runs where not (agent_id = 'harness.synthetic' and agent_version = 1))

preconditions.name: existing_steps_fit_h2_step_type_allowlist
preconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from public.agent_run_steps where step_type not in ('synthetic_noop', 'synthetic_transient_failure', 'synthetic_permanent_failure', 'synthetic_delay', 'tool_invocation'))

preconditions.name: h1_queue_present_and_logged
preconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pgmq.meta where queue_name = 'patelrep_agent_runs_v1' and not is_unlogged)

preconditions.name: domain_tables_present
preconditions.probe: select to_regclass('public.work_orders') is not null and to_regclass('public.operational_audit_events') is not null and to_regclass('public.user_roles') is not null and to_regclass('public.tenant_feature_flags') is not null

postconditions.name: h2_agent_allowlist_replaces_h1_synthetic_only
postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_h2_agent_allowlist' and convalidated) and not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_h1_synthetic_only')

postconditions.name: state_check_adds_only_awaiting_approval
postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_state_check' and convalidated and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%awaiting_approval%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%dead_letter%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%cancel_requested%')

postconditions.name: step_type_allowlist_replaces_regex
postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_run_steps'::regclass and conname = 'agent_run_steps_step_type_allowlist' and convalidated) and not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_run_steps'::regclass and conname = 'agent_run_steps_step_type_check')

postconditions.name: gateway_insert_trigger_enabled
postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_trigger where tgrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and tgname = 'agent_runs_guard_gateway_insert' and tgenabled = 'O')

postconditions.name: h1_transitions_preserved
postconditions.probe: select public.agent_run_transition_allowed('queued', 'running') and public.agent_run_transition_allowed('running', 'succeeded') and public.agent_run_transition_allowed('running', 'retry_wait') and public.agent_run_transition_allowed('paused', 'queued') and not public.agent_run_transition_allowed('succeeded', 'running') and not public.agent_run_transition_allowed('awaiting_approval', 'running')

postconditions.name: new_tables_rls_enabled
postconditions.probe: select count(*) = 7 and bool_and(relrowsecurity) from pg_class where relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and relkind = 'r' and relname in ('agent_execution_enablement', 'agent_tool_controls', 'agent_tool_grants', 'agent_tool_invocations', 'agent_tool_approvals', 'agent_tool_executions', 'agent_tool_events')

postconditions.name: new_tables_closed_to_end_users
postconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from pg_class c cross join unnest(array['anon', 'authenticated']) as r(role_name) where c.relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and c.relkind = 'r' and c.relname in ('agent_execution_enablement', 'agent_tool_controls', 'agent_tool_grants', 'agent_tool_invocations', 'agent_tool_approvals', 'agent_tool_executions', 'agent_tool_events') and (has_table_privilege(r.role_name, c.oid, 'SELECT') or has_table_privilege(r.role_name, c.oid, 'INSERT') or has_table_privilege(r.role_name, c.oid, 'UPDATE') or has_table_privilege(r.role_name, c.oid, 'DELETE')))

postconditions.name: agent_functions_backend_only
postconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and (p.proname like 'agent%' or p.proname = 'work_order_assign_apply') and (p.prosecdef or has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') or has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'EXECUTE')))

postconditions.name: gateway_execution_disabled
postconditions.probe: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(not enabled) from public.agent_execution_enablement

postconditions.name: no_tool_grants_and_no_gateway_runs
postconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from public.agent_tool_grants) and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_runs where agent_id <> 'harness.synthetic')

postconditions.name: h1_queue_still_logged
postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pgmq.meta where queue_name = 'patelrep_agent_runs_v1' and not is_unlogged) and (select count(*) from pgmq.meta) = 1

preconditions.name: h2_allowlist_present_without_orchestrator
preconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_h2_agent_allowlist' and contype = 'c' and convalidated and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) not like '%harness.orchestrator%') and not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_h3_agent_allowlist')

preconditions.name: h2_step_allowlist_without_model_planning
preconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_run_steps'::regclass and conname = 'agent_run_steps_step_type_allowlist' and contype = 'c' and convalidated and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) not like '%model_planning%')

preconditions.name: gateway_insert_trigger_present_without_planning_marker
preconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_trigger t join pg_proc p on p.oid = t.tgfoid where t.tgrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and t.tgname = 'agent_runs_guard_gateway_insert' and t.tgenabled = 'O' and p.proname = 'agent__guard_gateway_run_insert' and p.prosrc not like '%agent_planning_admission%')

preconditions.name: h3_objects_absent
preconditions.probe: select to_regclass('public.agent_model_enablement') is null and to_regclass('public.agent_model_price_schedules') is null and to_regclass('public.agent_model_budget_policies') is null and to_regclass('public.agent_model_budget_counters') is null and to_regclass('public.agent_model_attempts') is null and to_regclass('public.agent_model_spend_events') is null and to_regclass('public.agent_planning_runs') is null and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc where pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and (proname like 'agent_model%' or proname like 'agent__model%' or proname like 'agent_planning%' or proname like 'agent__planning%' or proname = 'agent__guard_planning_run'))

preconditions.name: existing_runs_fit_h3_allowlist
preconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from public.agent_runs where not ((agent_id = 'harness.synthetic' and agent_version = 1) or (agent_id = 'engineering.dispatch_assistant' and agent_version = 1 and synthetic_spec = '{}'::jsonb)))

preconditions.name: h1_queue_present_and_logged
preconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pgmq.meta where queue_name = 'patelrep_agent_runs_v1' and not is_unlogged) and (select count(*) from pgmq.meta) = 1

preconditions.name: gateway_execution_disabled
preconditions.probe: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(not enabled) from public.agent_execution_enablement

postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_h3_agent_allowlist' and contype = 'c' and convalidated and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%harness.orchestrator%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%engineering.dispatch_assistant%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%harness.synthetic%') and not exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and conname = 'agent_runs_h2_agent_allowlist')

postconditions.name: step_allowlist_adds_only_model_planning
postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.agent_run_steps'::regclass and conname = 'agent_run_steps_step_type_allowlist' and contype = 'c' and convalidated and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%model_planning%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%tool_invocation%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%synthetic_noop%' and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%synthetic_delay%')

postconditions.name: insert_guard_requires_planning_marker
postconditions.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_trigger t join pg_proc p on p.oid = t.tgfoid where t.tgrelid = 'public.agent_runs'::regclass and t.tgname = 'agent_runs_guard_gateway_insert' and t.tgenabled = 'O' and p.proname = 'agent__guard_gateway_run_insert' and p.prosrc like '%agent_planning_admission%' and p.prosrc like '%agent_gateway_admission%')

postconditions.probe: select count(*) = 7 and bool_and(relrowsecurity) from pg_class where relnamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and relkind = 'r' and relname in ('agent_model_enablement', 'agent_model_price_schedules', 'agent_model_budget_policies', 'agent_model_budget_counters', 'agent_model_attempts', 'agent_model_spend_events', 'agent_planning_runs')

postconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and (p.proname like 'agent%' or p.proname = 'work_order_assign_apply') and (p.prosecdef or has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') or has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'EXECUTE')))

postconditions.name: paid_calls_disabled

postconditions.name: no_budget_policies_no_spend
postconditions.probe: select not exists (select 1 from public.agent_model_budget_policies) and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_model_budget_counters) and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_model_attempts) and not exists (select 1 from public.agent_model_spend_events)
